description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Timeless Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
